note: The answer key the trees are checked against. A tree passes a film when the film is in its pool; overlap between trees is expected. must_reach names a tree a film must be in; must_not names a tree it must not be in. The lists are read from genome list tags at check time, so they need no copy of any published list. hidden lists every [tree, kind] pair the 30-film bar hides in this library; the checker fails when the hidden kinds differ from it.
